features.name: heavy_atom_burden_log
features.description: Log-scaled total heavy-atom-like count combining several atom/group counters; smooth severity proxy for molecular size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth monotone size proxy useful as a linear margin contributor.

features.name: halogen_like_intensity
features.description: Sum of low-frequency halogen/heteroatom-style counters scaled by log1p; captures presence of rare substituents.
features.expected_model_benefit: Sparse-but-informative directional signal; linear-friendly continuous scaling.

features.name: v8_zscore
features.description: Standardized V8 using training mean/std; smooth centered feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centered/scaled inputs improve linear SVM margin geometry.

features.name: v30_zscore
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides comparable-scale predictor for linear projection.

features.name: v31_log_scaled
features.description: log1p compression of V31 (long-tailed) for smoother linear response.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses heavy tail to improve linear separability.

features.name: topological_density_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V15 to V39 (two related topological indices); captures relative structural compactness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratios between correlated descriptors provide informative linear directions.

features.name: v13_to_v1_ratio
features.description: Ratio of V13 to V1, two correlated structural descriptors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative structural index; bounded smooth ratio.

features.name: v36_v37_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of V36 and V37 (related descriptors), centered.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear combination of correlated features acts as denoised projection.

features.name: shape_index_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of V17 from its training mean - signals shape-index anomalies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous deviation magnitude separates atypical molecules.

features.name: polarity_proxy
features.description: Combination of V12 (signed) and V28 (signed) standardized; captures polarity-like dipole signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth signed score directly usable in linear margin.

features.name: heteroatom_to_size_ratio
features.description: Ratio of summed rare substituent counts to overall heavy-atom burden; relative heteroatom density.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes substituent counts by size; smooth and bounded for linear models.

features.name: structural_persistence_score
features.description: Semantic judgment combining stable structural indices (V1, V13, V15, V18, V22, V27, V36, V39) into a single normalized 0-1 score reflecting how 'large/complex/persistent' a molecule appears based on topological-index magnitudes; computed as clipped mean of z-scored components mapped to [0,1] via a logistic-like transform.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an interpretable smooth aggregated severity score that aligns with persistence-related chemistry intuition useful for a linear margin.
